applicability: code-level messages naming an authority; excludes prompts, which are writer behavior by construction
destination: AGENTS.md Adding a defensive branch to a fleet script (diagnostic-message twin)
expected_behavior: A diagnostic naming an external authority is backed by a reader that consulted that authority, or the message names what was actually compared.
observation: A workflow guard compared two fields of the same agent-reported packet to each other and reported 'scope candidate_sha did not match git HEAD'. The file never invokes git, so an operator following that message checks a value that will match and loses the cycle to a fabricated diagnosis.
reason: Sibling of the shipped doc-side twin rule in the same section: that rule governs prose claiming enforcement, this governs a runtime message claiming a check. Merging generalizes one rule rather than appending a second per-incident entry.
scope: diagnostic messages emitted by fleet scripts and workflows

sensitivity_review.statement: Operator attested that the candidate contains no raw transcripts, secrets, credentials, or executable instructions.
